nuggets.text: Season-ticket holder Marty Whims II won a drawing to help Joe Moorhead call the Zips' opening drive on Saturday.
The Zips' post announcing their fan offensive coordinator contest drew more than 23 million views.
The Zips' fan play-caller contest sparked the largest ticket sales day in Akron athletics history.
The Zips name comes from Zippers, rubber overshoes made by Akron's B.F. Goodrich; it was shortened to Zips in 1950.
Zippy, the Zips' mascot, is a female kangaroo who went 13-0 to win the Capital One Bowl mascot challenge.
The Zips were the first school to move up from Division I-AA to Division I-A, making the jump in 1987.
Zips coach Joe Moorhead played for the Munich Cowboys in Germany after quarterbacking Fordham.
The Zips' final game at the Rubber Bowl in 2008 went four overtimes, the first such game in school history.
Pro Football Hall of Famer Jason Taylor was a three-year starter for the Zips from 1993 to 1995.
Zips running back Jordan Gant ran for 1,032 yards and six touchdowns last season.
